limitations: L1: A water gel composition, including (a) a hydrophilic network monomer; (b) a hydrophobic network monomer; (c) a zwitterionic compound; (d) a cross-linking agent; (e) an initiator.
L2: The hydrophilic network monomer is selected from one or more of methyl methacrylate, acrylic acid, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, and methacrylic acid.
L3: The hydrophobic network monomer is selected from one or more of methyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate lauryl ester, methyl methacrylate isobornyl ester, styrene, and ethyl silane.

L4: The zwitterionic compound is selected from one or more of 3-(2-methylacryloyloxyethyl diethylaminoethyl) propylsulfonic salt, 3-(tri(2-hydroxyethyl)ammonium) propyl-1-sulfonic salt, 3-(acrylamidopropyl diethylaminoethyl) propylsulfonic salt, 1-(3-sulfopropyl)-2-ethylvinylpyridinium tosylate, 2-methylacryloyloxyethyl phosphocholine, and 2-[3-acrylamidopropyl] diethylammonium ethyl 2'-isopropylphosphate.
L5: The cross-linking agent is selected from one or more of polyethylene glycol diacrylate, N,N-bis(acryloyl) piperazine, and diethylaminoethyl methacrylate.
L6: The initiator is selected from one or more of benzoin, α-ketoglutaric acid, and 2,2-diethoxyacetophenone.

L7: The water gel composition includes the following proportions of each component: (a) hydrophilic network monomer, 200-400 parts by weight; (b) hydrophobic network monomer, 50 parts by weight; (c) zwitterionic compound, 50-250 parts by weight; (d) cross-linking agent, 2-20 parts by weight; (e) initiator, 0.5-5 parts by weight.
